SEV = {"Critical": "C00000", "High": "E36C09", "Medium": "BF9000", "Low": "4F81BD"}

def shade(cell, hexcolor):
    tcPr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    shd = OxmlElement("w:shd")
    shd.set(qn("w:val"), "clear")
    shd.set(qn("w:color"), "auto")
    shd.set(qn("w:fill"), hexcolor)
    tcPr.append(shd)

def add_runs(p, text):
    # **bold** markup
    parts = text.split("**")
    for i, part in enumerate(parts):
        if part:
            r = p.add_run(part)
            if i % 2 == 1:
                r.bold = True
    return p

def H(text, level=1):
    return doc.add_heading(text, level=level)

def P(text, italic=False, size=None, align=None, space_after=6):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    add_runs(p, text)
    if italic:
        for r in p.runs: r.italic = True
    if size:
        for r in p.runs: r.font.size = Pt(size)
    if align == "center":
        p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(space_after)
    return p

def B(text, level=0):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style="List Bullet" if level == 0 else "List Bullet 2")
    add_runs(p, text)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return p

def N(text):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style="List Number")
    add_runs(p, text)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return p

def T(header, rows, widths=None, sevcol=None, fontsize=9):
    t = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=len(header))
    t.style = "Table Grid"
    t.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    hdr = t.rows[0].cells
    for i, h in enumerate(header):
        hdr[i].text = ""
        r = hdr[i].paragraphs[0].add_run(h)
        r.bold = True
        r.font.size = Pt(fontsize)
        r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF)
        shade(hdr[i], "1F3A5F")
    for row in rows:
        cells = t.add_row().cells
        for i, val in enumerate(row):
            cells[i].text = ""
            p = cells[i].paragraphs[0]
            add_runs(p, str(val))
            for r in p.runs:
                r.font.size = Pt(fontsize)
            if sevcol is not None and i == sevcol and val in SEV:
                shade(cells[i], SEV[val])
                for r in p.runs:
                    r.bold = True
                    r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF)
    # repeat header row
    trPr = t.rows[0]._tr.get_or_add_trPr()
    th = OxmlElement("w:tblHeader"); th.set(qn("w:val"), "true"); trPr.append(th)
    if widths:
        for row in t.rows:
            for i, w in enumerate(widths):
                row.cells[i].width = Inches(w)
    doc.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return t

def ISSUE(code, title, sev, sources, finding, matters, recs):
    H(code + "  " + title, 3)
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    r = p.add_run("Severity: "); r.bold = True
    r2 = p.add_run(sev); r2.bold = True; r2.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(SEV[sev])
    r3 = p.add_run("     Sources: "); r3.bold = True
    p.add_run(sources)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(3)
    q = doc.add_paragraph(); rr = q.add_run("Finding."); rr.bold = True; rr.italic = True
    q.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    for f in finding: B(f)
    q = doc.add_paragraph(); rr = q.add_run("Why it matters."); rr.bold = True; rr.italic = True
    q.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    for m in matters: B(m)
    q = doc.add_paragraph(); rr = q.add_run("Recommendation."); rr.bold = True; rr.italic = True
    q.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    for x in recs: B(x)
